skill.name: jira-workflow
skill.description: Manage Jira story proposals, approvals, workflow transitions, and completion updates through Jira REST API guidance.
skill.summary: Guides Jira story creation, approval, workflow transition, and completion updates for development teams.

security_audit.summary: Most static external-command findings are false positives from Markdown backticks, code fences, and JavaScript template literals. The real risks are expected Jira integration behaviors: reading Jira environment variables and making authenticated REST calls that create, transition, or comment on issues. No prompt injection or malicious intent was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.suggestion: Validate JIRA_BASE_URL against a trusted Atlassian domain before sending Basic auth, and never log Jira API tokens.
Keep explicit user approval before issue creation, workflow transitions, and comments. Add dry-run guidance for unapproved work.
Include the referenced scripts or remove the command examples so users do not run unreviewed external files.

content.value_statement: Jira work often drifts from implementation when stories, approvals, and status changes live in separate tools. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through approved story creation, transitions, and completion updates.
actual_capabilities: Drafts SAFe-style Jira stories with acceptance criteria and definition of done.
Prompts for user approval before creating Jira issues.
Shows how to create Jira stories and subtasks through Jira REST API v3.
Queries available Jira transitions before moving an issue between workflow states.
Adds work log and implementation detail comments to Jira issues.
Coordinates TodoWrite progress with Jira issue status changes.
limitations: Requires Jira email, API token, base URL, project key, and board information.
Cannot verify live Jira workflows without access to the target Jira project.
Documented script commands depend on script files that are not present in this package.
Does not replace Jira permission controls or organizational approval policies.

use_cases.title: Plan Approved Stories
use_cases.description: Turn feature requests into SAFe-style Jira stories before creating work items.

use_cases.title: Keep Development Status Current
use_cases.description: Move Jira issues through To Do, Progressing, review, and Done as implementation progresses.

use_cases.title: Synchronize Delivery Notes
use_cases.description: Add implementation details, modified files, and completion notes to Jira when work finishes.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Story Proposal
prompt_templates.prompt: Use jira-workflow to draft a Jira story for [feature]. Include persona, goal, benefit, acceptance criteria, and definition of done. Do not create it yet.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare an Approved Issue
prompt_templates.prompt: Use jira-workflow to present a Jira story for [task]. Ask for my approval before creating the issue in project [KEY].

prompt_templates.title: Transition Active Work
prompt_templates.prompt: Use jira-workflow to check available transitions for [ISSUE-KEY]. Move it to [target state] only if the transition exists.

prompt_templates.title: Run End-to-End Delivery Sync
prompt_templates.prompt: Use jira-workflow to manage [epic or task]. Create approved stories, track TodoWrite progress, add completion comments, and transition finished issues to Done.

output_examples.input: Create a story for password reset.
output_examples.output: The skill returns a proposed Jira story with a user story, acceptance criteria, subtasks, and an approval question.
The skill checks Jira transitions, identifies the Progressing transition, and reports whether the issue was moved.

output_examples.input: Mark SCRUM-100 done with implementation notes.
output_examples.output: The skill prepares a completion comment, adds implementation details, and transitions the issue to Done when allowed.

best_practices: Confirm story content with the user before creating or changing Jira issues.
Verify JIRA_BASE_URL points to the correct Atlassian site before using credentials.
Query available transitions before choosing a target workflow state.
anti_patterns: Do not create Jira issues from vague requests without acceptance criteria.
Do not send Jira API tokens to unverified hosts or shared logs.
Do not assume every Jira project uses the same transition names.

faq.question: What credentials are required?
faq.answer: A Jira email, API token, base URL, project key, and board ID are expected.

faq.question: Does it create issues automatically?
faq.answer: It instructs the assistant to ask for user approval before creating Jira items.

faq.question: Can it work with team-managed Jira?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents Team-managed states and uses the parent field for Epic links.

faq.question: Can it transition issues?
faq.answer: Yes. It first queries available transitions and then posts a valid transition ID.

faq.question: Does this package include executable scripts?
faq.answer: The audited package only lists SKILL.md, so referenced scripts may need a separate source.

faq.question: Is it suitable for Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes TodoWrite synchronization guidance for Claude Code workflows.
